text: Added §18, requiring each new mechanism to be checked through the host’s real post-backward gradient assembly, optimizer update, and matched SID export before claiming it affected training. It follows H105-01/H105-04 and the measured finding that encoder-only auxiliary gradients were overwritten, leaving trained weights and SIDs identical to control. The section also says ER alone is not sufficient evidence of downstream success, consistent with H105-02/H105-03; it does not change any judge, threshold, fixture, or evaluation.
